get.description: Returns the AUTHENTICATED caller's assignment-driven approver inbox — the tickets awaiting the caller, each paired with the caller's own current-stage assignment and the ticket's per-approver stage progress. This is 'assignments where I am a pending approver', NOT every pending ticket in the tenant (that is the tenant-wide pending-queue capability). The acting identity is resolved inside the use case — never a query param. Gated on approvals_read inside the use case. The inbox has a fixed order (earliest expiry first with no-deadline tickets last, then oldest first); an explicit $orderby is refused with 400.

Returns the count of the AUTHENTICATED caller's approver inbox — the sibling /Count of Pending, counting the SAME assignment-driven set so the badge count never drifts from the list. Gated on approvals_read inside the use case.

get.summary: Get one approval + its full assignment set
get.description: Returns a single approval ticket with its FULL approver assignment set across all stages (who approved / is still required / was superseded) — the read the decide flyout drills into. The ticket is loaded tenant-ownership-scoped (a foreign-tenant ticket is a 404, fail-closed). Gated on approvals_read inside the use case.

post.summary: Record a decision on a pending approval
post.description: Records the terminal human approve/reject decision on a pending ticket and resumes the gated action EXACTLY ONCE. The decider identity is the AUTHENTICATED caller — never this body, which carries only the outcome, an optional reason and an optional evidence reference. The ticket is loaded tenant-ownership-scoped (a foreign-tenant ticket is a 404, fail-closed); the aggregate enforces the Pending guard, the Approved/Rejected guard, and separation of duties (self-approval refused unless the policy allows). Gated on approvals_decide inside the use case. The body may name an optional expected stage; when the ticket has since advanced past it, the decision is refused rather than recorded against the new stage.

Withdraws a pending ticket before a decision is made (on behalf of a consumer whose run already ended). Cancel does NOT fire a resolution handler — there is nothing to resume — it only notifies the delivery adapters; a later decision on a cancelled ticket fails the Pending guard. The ticket is loaded tenant-ownership-scoped (a foreign-tenant ticket is a 404). Gated on approvals_manage inside the use case.

post.summary: Reassign a pending approval to a different approver
post.description: Re-routes a pending ticket's CURRENT stage to a different approver — the manual counterpart to the escalation Reassign action. The body names a TARGET the resolver fans out over: a Person value (one principal) or a Role value (every current member). The service supersedes the stage's still-open assignments and materialises fresh ones for the target, staying Pending (a re-route, never an outcome — no resolution fires). The acting administrator is the AUTHENTICATED caller — never this body. The ticket is loaded tenant-ownership-scoped (a foreign-tenant ticket is a 404). Gated on approvals_manage inside the use case.
